API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIServer ManagementUpdates the Server details for the specified ID.
Updates the Server details for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/server/:serverId

Updates the Server details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

serverId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Server.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. Pass microtenantId as null to retrieve data from all customers associated with the tenant.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
address
string
appServerGroupIds
string[]
configSpace
string

Possible values: [DEFAULT, SIEM]

creationTime
int32
description
string
enabled
boolean
REQUIRED
id
int64
microtenantId
int64
microtenantName
string
modifiedBy
int64
modifiedTime
int32
name
string
REQUIRED
